रच् {c10c} U. (रचयति-ते, रचित)
1 To
arrange, prepare, make ready,
contrive, plan; पुष्पाणां प्रकरः स्मितेन
रचितो नो कुंदजात्यादिभिः

.
--2
To make, form, effect, create,
produce; मायाविकल्परचितैः स्यंदनैः

.
--3 To write, compose,
put together (as a work); अश्वधाटीं
जगन्नाथो विश्वहृद्यामरीरचत्

;
Ś. 3. 15.
--4 To place in or upon,
[]
fix on; रचयति चिकुरे कुरबककुसुमं

रचनं --ना [रच्-युच्]
1 Arrangement,
preparation, disposition; अभिषेक˚,
संगीत˚ &c.
--2 Formation, creation,
production; अन्यैव कापि रचना
वचनावलीनां

.
--3 Performance, completion,
accomplishment, effecting; कुरु मम
वचनं सत्वररचनं

.
--4 A literary work or production,
work, composition; संक्षिप्ता
वस्तुरचना S.

.
--5 Dressing the hair.
--6
An array or arrangement of troops.
--7 A creation of the mind, an
artificial fancy.
--8 Stringing together
(flowers &c.).

रचित p. p.
1 Arranged.
--2
Prepared
--3 Made, formed.
--4 Strung
together.
--5 Composed, written.

--7 Furnished with.
--8
